QA-29237 (Thursday rotation) is PASS for two of its three legs, and the Spotify leg is BLOCKED. The report is at `results/2026-10-29/QA-29237-report.md`.

- **Spotify / Spotify News:** BLOCKED because the brand doesn't exist on dev. I confirmed it with three typeahead queries and used no substitute.
- **Sony Pictures Television:** PASS. Impressions are shown on all 200 rendered TikTok posts (of 207). Organic and Paid Impressions are "–" on all 200. Engagement Rate matches Engagements / Impressions on all 200.
- **Ralph Lauren:** PASS, same results on 200 of 243 TikTok posts.
- **Reach check:** the Organic + Paid = Reach assertion passes only vacuously, because Reach, Organic Reach and Paid Reach are "–" on every TikTok post.
- **Rendered posts:** the table shows 200 posts per page with no pagination, so the remaining posts weren't evaluated. The Sum row covers all of them.

The overall verdict follows the 2026-10-27 precedent of calling a case PASS when its runnable legs pass. No bugs were filed, and QA-29278 did not reproduce.
